title: Shaft Alignment System
model_title: Shaft Alignment with Dial Indicators (Rim-and-Face) — Shims & Jacking Bolts

introduction.definition: Shaft alignment brings the shafts of a driver and a driven machine onto one centreline. With dial indicators on a bracket, both shafts are turned together and rim and face readings give the offset and angularity; the movable machine (usually the motor) is then shimmed and moved with jacking bolts until within tolerance.
applications: Any coupled rotating machinery after installation or maintenance
introduction.summary: Shaft alignment with dial indicators measures how far the shafts of two coupled machines are offset and angled, so the movable machine can be shimmed and moved until both shafts share one centreline.

pressure.title: Offset and angularity — measure, then correct
pressure.description: Two shafts are aligned when their rotational centrelines are collinear at running temperature. Misalignment has two parts: offset (parallel displacement) and angularity (slope), each vertical and horizontal. With the bracket on one hub, rotating both shafts together and reading the rim (radial) and face (axial) indicators at 12, 3, 6 and 9 o'clock gives offset (½ the rim reading change) and angularity (face difference ÷ diameter). Correct vertical errors with shims under the movable machine's feet, horizontal with jacking bolts; check soft foot first. Typical tolerances at 1500 rpm ≈ 0.05–0.08 mm offset (follow site / maker tables).

script.narration: This module introduces the Shaft Alignment System.
Shaft alignment brings the shafts of a driver and a driven machine onto one centreline.

With dial indicators on a bracket, both shafts are turned together and rim and face readings give the offset and angularity; the movable machine (usually the motor) is then shimmed and moved with jacking bolts until within tolerance.
Typical applications include pump–motor, fan–motor and gearbox trains; any coupled rotating machinery after installation or maintenance.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Pump Shaft & Coupling Hub (turning with brackets), Motor Shaft & Coupling Hub.

video_tutorials.title: Shaft Alignment System — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Shaft Alignment System.
Check indicators and bracket sag before use.
Re-check alignment after pipe work / hot run.
Calibrate indicators.
Watch for wrong readings: results do not repeat. Common cause: bracket sag, loose mounting, soft foot.
Watch for misalignment returns: vibration after start. Common cause: pipe strain, thermal growth.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
